title: Billing email templates: aim for end of month
transcript:
[00:00] Hannah: Morning. Main thing today is the billing email templates. Tomasz, where did we land with the rendering bug?
[00:09] Tomasz: Fixed on Monday. Outlook was stripping the header table, so I rebuilt it with plain divs. It renders fine in all the test inboxes now.
[00:24] Aiko: Nice. Did that cover the dark mode version too?
[00:29] Tomasz: Mostly. The logo still looks muddy on a black background. I've asked design for a light variant.
[00:41] Hannah: OK. What's left before we can switch every customer over to the new templates?
[00:48] Tomasz: Three templates. The invoice, the failed payment one, and the receipt. Receipts are the hard part because of the tax lines per country.
[01:06] Aiko: How many countries are we talking about?
[01:10] Tomasz: Eleven with VAT, plus the US sales tax block. I want a snapshot test for each one.
[01:24] Hannah: That's sensible. Any blockers?
[01:28] Tomasz: The tax copy. Finance still owes me the wording for reverse charge invoices.
[01:37] Hannah: I'll chase finance today.
[01:42] Aiko: From my side, the new templates are what the autumn campaign links to. The footer has the new referral block.
[01:55] Hannah: Right. So let's aim for end of month for the full switch-over. Tomasz, does that work?
[02:04] Tomasz: End of month should be doable if finance gets back to me this week.
[02:12] Aiko: OK, end of month. I'll plan around that.
[02:18] Hannah: Good. Tomasz, can you also turn off the old templates once the switch is done, so we don't send both?
[02:27] Tomasz: Yes, I'll delete them from the sender config after a day of clean sends.
[02:36] Aiko: One more thing. Can we get a preview link for the referral block? Legal wants to read the terms in context.
[02:47] Tomasz: I'll send one this afternoon.
[02:52] Aiko: Thanks. The campaign copy is with the translators, so I can't change the referral wording after this week.
[03:04] Hannah: Noted. Let's keep that wording frozen, then. Thanks, both.
